newsitem.title: CANADA: CanOxy buys C$6.2 mln of Saskatchewan land.
newsitem.headline: CanOxy buys C$6.2 mln of Saskatchewan land.

text.p: Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd said on Friday it acquired 156,000 acres of land at the province of Saskatchewan's October land sale for just over C$40 per acre.
CanOxy said 153,000 acres were in five contiguous blocks just north of the Primrose Lake Air Weapons Range in northwest Saskatchewan.
The company said it identified the acreage as having multi-zone natural gas potential in mid-1995 and completed a 110-mile seismic program last winter.
The lands represent a large expansion of the company's undeveloped acreage base and will be the site of an active natural gas exploration program starting this winter, it said.
CanOxy chief executive David Hentschel said in a statement that the company's Canadian division added 700,000 net acres of undeveloped land in the past 18 months.
Acreage was acquired at Stoddart in northeast British Columbia, the west-central Saskatchewan heavy oil belt and most recently, the shallow gas play in northern Saskatchewan.
